title: PRAME Logic-First Transfer
subtitle: A review-required demonstration centered on decision logic and evidence boundaries
research_goal: Show how a transfer-oriented run can present mechanism, assay validity, and an unresolved human decision without implying experimental validation.
summary: The synthetic run organizes a target-selection argument around explicit causal links and a verifier-first decision gate. It remains review-required because the demonstration intentionally leaves one evidence boundary unresolved.
scientific_decision: Review the target-context gate before any experimental recommendation. The portal does not convert a literature-supported component into a candidate-level claim.

timeline.label: Transfer framing
timeline.detail: A transferable question and non-goals were separated.

timeline.label: Boundary review
timeline.detail: Direct and analogical support were labeled separately.

timeline.label: Human decision
timeline.detail: One target-context assumption remains open for review.
